judgments.reason: The OSF record 10.17605/osf.io/ktv7m is the original EEGEyeNet deposit by the same authors, and this BIDS dataset is a subject subset derived from it.
The EEGEyeNet paper presents the dataset itself (simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking); the BIDS version is a one-subject subset of it, with matching authors (Płomecka, Kastrati).
judgments.paper_title: EEGEyeNet: a Simultaneous Electroencephalography and Eye-tracking Dataset and Benchmark for Eye Movement Prediction

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing data into BIDS, used to convert this dataset; it does not describe the EEGEyeNet data itself.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the EEGEyeNet data itself.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
